memory_update.text: VECO should be promoted as the primary US-exchange-listed underfollowed candidate for the compound semiconductor photonics tools node; evidence is strongest where Veeco explicitly maps Lumina MOCVD and other tools to InP laser manufacturing driven by AI infrastructure.

AIXNY/AIXTRON is highly relevant to the node but should be handled as a US-traded ADR/liquidity exception rather than a clean US-listed exchange candidate until listing, liquidity, and investability are verified.

LITE and COHR validate the demand chain from AI datacenter networking to InP lasers, silicon photonics, CPO, and higher-speed optical modules, but both are now high-attention reference names rather than underfollowed discovery candidates.

Need a follow-up pass for US-listed niche materials and wafer suppliers tied to InP/GaAs/VCSEL substrates, epitaxy consumables, specialty gases, metrology, inspection, and photonics test equipment; this pass found stronger tool and component anchors than pure scarce-material candidates.

node: Compound semiconductor epitaxy and photonics manufacturing tools
summary: Expanded the universe around AI optical-interconnect manufacturing bottlenecks, with emphasis on MOCVD, InP lasers, silicon-photonics manufacturing tools, and upstream photonics capacity. The strongest direct US-exchange-listed underfollowed equipment candidate found in this pass is Veeco. Aixtron remains a key reference/underfollowed European toolmaker but is only US-traded via OTC ADR, so it should be treated as a liquidity/listing exception. Lumentum and Coherent are included as reference demand anchors because their InP laser and AI datacenter optics ramps help validate the upstream tool demand chain, but they are no longer underfollowed small/mid-cap candidates.
